Laplace’s Demon — Cursed Technique Reversal

describes how a deterministic system can nonetheless exhibit behavior that is impossible to predict: as in the butterfly effect, minor variations between the starting conditions of two systems can result in major differences. You can spend 4 cursed energy as a reaction to instead of using logic, force a chaotic rush of extremity for 2 minutes. You gain the following benefits for the duration: ● When you make attack rolls, you treat a creature’s AC as being lowered by your Intelligence modifier. ● When you miss an attack roll, you have advantage on your next attack against that creature. ● Roll a D4 at the start of your turn. Depending on the outcome, you must take the following action as a bonus action: (1: Hide, 2: Disengage, 3: Dash, 4: Attack, (one melee attack))
